title: A Letter About a Job
text:
I am writing to ask about the office assistant job on your website. I have worked in an office for three years, so I have good experience. I speak English well and I can use a computer. I would like to know if the job is still open.

Please send me more information about the job and the application process. I am available for an interview on weekday afternoons. Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.text: How many years has the writer worked in an office?
When is the writer available for an interview?
What can the reader most likely conclude about the writer?
options: The writer is probably looking for work
The writer is probably a teacher
The writer does not speak English
The writer does not want an interview

questions.text: What is the most likely relationship between the writer and the reader?
options: The writer is a possible employee and the reader is an employer
The writer is a student and the reader is a teacher

vocabulary.definition: knowledge or skill gained from doing something for a period of time
a meeting where someone asks questions to decide if they will get a job
a formal request for a job, often made in writing
free and ready to do something at a certain time

paragraph_translations: Piszę, aby zapytać o ofertę pracy na stanowisko asystenta biurowego, zamieszczoną na Państwa stronie internetowej. Od trzech lat pracuję w biurze, więc mam dobre doświadczenie. Dobrze mówię po angielsku i potrafię obsługiwać komputer. Chcę wiedzieć, czy to stanowisko jest nadal wolne.

Proszę o przesłanie dodatkowych informacji o pracy oraz o procedurze składania podania. Mogę przyjść na rozmowę kwalifikacyjną w dni robocze po południu. Dziękuję za poświęcony czas. Z niecierpliwością czekam na odpowiedź.
